model.title: A resolution recognizing Hispanic Heritage Month and celebrating the heritage and culture of Latinos in the United States and the immense contributions of Latinos to the United States.

summary.text: The resolution recognizes Hispanic Heritage Month, running from September 15 to October 15, 2026, and honors the central role Latinos and their many heritages play in the country's economy, culture, and identity. It also encourages people across the United States to observe the month with programs and activities that celebrate Latino contributions to the nation.
